items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Well Gladys and Claude were my managers.

ctx.x: Were you using the name Sullivan?

No, no. Claude is responsible for the Sullivan. I think was to sort of throw people off the track. No, no. Actually, there was a singer in New York at the time who was -- I imagined she was under contract to Columbia, and she also had a sustaining show called Midge Williams. See my name is Williams. I think that he probably changed it to keep the confusion down. But anyway, getting back to Gladys and Claude, while in Pittsburgh -- You know, Pittsburgh is quite a theatrical town, and we had a lot of theatrical…
